decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting builds directly on the firm's deep knowledge of robust, standards-compliant specialist lighting, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and keep improving the line.
The spring-balanced desk lamp uses the firm's ergonomic office-lighting know-how but sits at the edge of its project-based core, so it carries a moderate drop risk without justifying withdrawal yet.
As a second-generation iteration of an existing interior luminaire, it draws fully on the firm's LED and in-house testing capabilities and stays central to its portfolio.
The marine HMI searchlight uses established marine expertise, but HMI technology runs against the firm's LED and sustainability direction, so the risk of a phase-out keeps rising.
The marine searchlight line fits the firm's established marine and robust-lighting competence, which lets it maintain and refine the product effectively.
